Microsoft's fiscal years 2023 and 2024 are both 12-month periods ended June 30, so the comparison is on a consistent fiscal-year basis. [DOC-1]

Gross profit and margin calculations:
- FY2024: Revenue $245,122M, Cost of revenue $74,114M → Gross profit = $171,008M → Gross margin = 171,008/245,122 ≈ 69.77% [DOC-1]
- FY2023: Revenue $211,915M, Cost of revenue $65,863M → Gross profit = $146,052M → Gross margin = 146,052/211,915 ≈ 68.92% [DOC-1]

Change in gross margin: 69.77% − 68.92% ≈ +0.85 percentage points, indicating an improvement in gross margin from FY2023 to FY2024.

ANSWER: Improved by approximately 0.85 percentage points (from ~68.92% in FY2023 to ~69.77% in FY2024)
